items.text: Kulondela hayumiyi Yesu hakufumaku, hakuya kwishinadi di kwawu dejiya daŊaliliya dodaTiberasi.
Hikukumulondela izaza deneni dawantu muloŋa anamoni dehi yinjikijilu yelililiyi akata.
Yesu hakukanduka mpidi, hakushakama kwenoku nawatumbanji twindi.
Henohu paseka, chawija chawaYudeya, chashika dehi kwakwihi.
Dichi Yesu hakufumbula mesu, hakumona antu amavulu adi nakwinza kudi yena, hakumwila Fwilipu nindi, Kudya tukupawila kudihi kulonda antu awa adiyi?
Chenochu wachihosheli nindi amutompi nachu; muloŋa yomweni neluki chakukeŋa kwilayi.
Fwilipu hakumwakula nindi, Yakudya yakulanda namali makulakaji ayedi kulonda antu ejima atambuli kanti kanti, hiyikuwaninaku.
Kambanji kindi wumu, Anderi mana kwaShimona Petulu,
hakumwila nindi, Kunu kudi kansi wukweti mankendi abali atanu, nitunyisaŋi tuyedi; indi yeniyi antu amavulu chishi ka hichi akuyiwanina?
Yesu hakwila nindi, Yishakamishenu antu. Henohu hadiŋi matahu amavulu. Amayala ashakamini; kuyichinda ashikili neyi kwiji makombakaji atanu.
Yesu hakutambula owu mankendi; chanasakililiyi, hakuyipaŋila antu anashakami; ninyisaŋi nawa mwomumu, mwonsu mwakeŋa eluwu.
Chanekutuwu, hakuyileja atumbanji twindi nindi, Nonenu yibalu yinashaluhu kulonda tubuli kuyikisaŋana.
Ayinona nikuyinona, hiyakwinzesha mabaŋu ikumi nayedi nayibalu yamankendi abali atanu yashiyiluwu antu heliluwu anadyi dehi.
Dichi antu chanamonuwu chinjikijilu cheliliyi, hiyakwila nawu, Chalala yeniwu diyi kaprofwetu elaŋawu nawu wakenza mumpata yamunu mwishina.
Yesu chanamoniyi antu hiyakukeŋa kwinza nakumukwata naŋovu amudiishi wanta, hakuwombolokela kumpidi kwakanka windi.
Chikuneli dehi melela atumbanji twindi hiyakukunkumukila kwijiya, eŋila nimuwatu.
Hiyakuzambuka hejiya, nawu ayi kuKaperinawu. Henohu kuneli dehi wufuku, Yesu niyena wuchidi kanda enzi kudi wena.
Ŋiya hidikutachika kwila mankanda amaneni, muloŋa wampepela yeneni yadiŋi nakukunka.
Cheliluwu wena anavuwi dehi kilometa jiwana indi kwiji jitanu, hiyakumona Yesu wudi nakwenda hewulu dameji, wudi nakuswila kwakwihi nawatu. Afwa nimutentu.
Yena hakuyila nindi, Yami aweni, bayi mutiyawomaku.
Atiya nikuwaha kumwiŋija muwatu; hohenohu watu wushika nikuchikumu kwadiŋi nakuyawu.
Chikunachi, izaza dasheli kwishinadi dejiya amona nawu kwadiŋi watu wumu hohu, nawu Yesu heŋila muwatu owu hamu nawatumbanji twinduku, afumakukanka wawu.
Ilaŋa kuTiberasi hikukufuma tumaatu twacheŋi, hitukushika kwakwihi nakwadiilawu mankendi, hasakililayi Mwanta.
Dichi izaza dawantu chabulili kumonawu Yesu, hela atumbanji twindi, wena hiyakwijila namutumaatu otu, hiyakuya nakumukeŋakeŋa Yesu kuKaperinawu.
Chanamuwanuwu kwishinadi dejiya hiyakumwila nawu, Eyi Rabi, wenza kunu ifukwinyi?
Yesu hakuyakula nindi, Chalala chalala, nukuyileja nami, chimunankeŋakeŋi hichinafumi hakumona yinjikijiluku, chinafumi hakwikuta mankendi mwadya.
Bayi mukalakelaŋa yakudya yanoŋaŋaku, chiŋa yakudya yashikaŋa nikuwumi wahaya nyaka yakuyinkayi Mwana kamuntu, diyi anafunduwu mufunda kudi Tata Nzambi.
Hiyakumwihula nawu, chiŋa twili ŋahi kulonda tukalakalaŋa nyidimu yaNzambi?
Yesu hakwakula nindi, Mudimu wakumukalakela Nzambi yowu kwitiya yena atemesheliyi.
Dichi wena hiyakumwihula nawu, Wukwila chinjikijilwinyi tuchimoni, tukwitiyi? Wakalakalaŋadi?
Ankakulula jetu adiilaŋa manina mwisaŋa, mwomwanasonekuwu munyikanda yajila nawu, Wayinkeli yakudya yakufuma mwiwulu, adiyi.
Kuchinka Yesu nindi, Chalala chalala, nukuyileja nami, Mosi hidiyi wayinkeli yakudya yakufuma mwiwuluku. Tata yami diyi wayinkaŋa a yakudya yalala yakufuma mwiwulu.
Muloŋa yakudya yaNzambi yowu wasulukili mwiwulu, wahandishaŋa ntu ampata yamunu mwishina.
Hiyakumwila nawu, Mwanta, atwinki yakudya oyu mafuku ejima.
Yesu hakuyila nindi, Ami yami nshima yawumi; muntu wukwinza kudami hakutiya cheŋi nzalaku, muntu wukunkuhwelela hamba katiya cheŋi mpwilaku.
Ilaŋa mi nayileji dehi nami, munanmoni dehi, enu kwitiya nehi.
Ejima akunyinkayi Tata diwu akwinza kudami; muntu wukwinza kudami, ami hinakamúumbaku.
Ichi chinasuluki mwiwulu hinalondi kwila muchima wamami awenuku, nalondi kwila muchima wayena wantemesheli.
Muchima wayena wantemesheli, nakeŋi yuma yejima yananvinkiyi nibuli kujimbeshahu hela chimu, chiŋa nakachisapula hefuku dakukuminina.
Muloŋa muchima waTata yami, nakeŋi antu ejima atalaŋa Mwana amwitiyaloŋa chakukuhwelela, muntu himuntu, amoni wumi wahaya nyaka, ninami nakamusaŋula hefuku dakukuminina.
AYudeya hiyakumutobela nanochu cheliliyi nindi, Yami nshima yasulukili mwiwulu.
Hiyakwila nawu, Yeniwu hidiyi Yesu, mwana kaYosefuku? Tata yindi namama yindi twayiluka. Indi yena welaŋa ŋahi nindi, Ami nasulukili mwiwulu?
Yesu hakuyakula nindi, Bayi mutobapaku.
Kwosi muntu natweshi kwinza kudami chakadi kumukoka kudi Tata wantemesheluku, ninami nakamusaŋula hefuku dakukuminina.
Anasoneki munyikanda yawatuprofwetu nawu, Antu ejima akayileja maana kudi Nzambi. Antu ejima anatiyi kudi Tata, anashinshiki, diwu akwinza kudami.
Hikwekala muntu wamonahu dehi Tataku, chiŋa iwu wafumini kudi Nzambi, diyi namoni Tata.
Chalala chalala, nukuyileja nami, muntu wukwitiya chakukuhwelela wukweti wumi wahaya nyaka.
Ami yami nshima yawumi.
Ankakulula jenu adiili manina mwisaŋa; afwili dehi.
Nshima yakudyayi muntu abuli kufwa, diyi yasulukili mwiwulu.
Ami yami nshima yayumi yasulukili mwiwulu. Neyi muntu wukudya kunshimiyi wakahandaŋa haya nyaka. Eŋa, nshima yinakahana kulonda antu ampata yamunu mwishina ahandi, diyi musunyi wami.
AYudeya hiyakutadika ntadi mukachi kawu, nawu, Muntu iwu wukutwesha kutwinka musunyi windi ŋahi, mwaka tuwidyi?
Dichi Yesu hakuyila nindi, Chalala chalala, nukuyileja nami, neyi mukubula kudya musunyi waMwana kamuntu, mubula kunwa nimashi indi, himukwikala nawumi mudenu awenuku.
Muntu wadyaloŋa musunyi wami, wanwaŋa nimashi ami, diyi wukweti wumi wahaya nyaka; ami nakamusaŋula hefuku dakukuminina.
Muloŋa musunyi wami hikudya kwalala, mashi ami hikunwa kwalala.
Muntu wadyaloŋa musunyi wami, wanwaŋa nimashi ami, diyi washakamaŋa mudami, ninami mudi yena.
Chantemesheliyi Tata wamumi, ninami chinukuhandila kudi Tata, dichi chakahandaŋa nimuntu waŋudyaloŋa.
Diyi yakudya yasulukili mwiwulu; hiyidi neyi yadiili ankakululaku, niwena afwa dehi; muntu wukudya yakudya iyi wakahanda haya nyaka.
Mazu awa hakuyihoshela mushikola chadiŋi nakulejayi antu kuKaperinawu.
Chachitiyiluwu atumbanji twindi amavulu hiyakwila nawu, Mazu awa akala; wukutwesha kutiyamu hinyi?
Yesu welukili mumuchima windi chadiŋi nakutobawu atumbanji hachumichi; hakuyila nindi, Munamoni chumichi kukala, tahindi?
Indi neyi mwakamona Mwana kamuntu hakukandama kwadiŋilaŋayi?
Spiritu diyi wahandishaŋa, kumujimba hiwukumwenaku chumaku. Mazu awa nahoshi nanenu, diyi spiritu, diwu wumi.
Ilaŋa hadenu hadi amu abula kwitiya. Muloŋa Yesu welukili kufumisha kutachi, ninawa abulili kwitiya, niwamba kamufukeja.
Yena nindi, Dichi nayileji nami, kwosi muntu wukutwesha kwinza kudamuku, chiŋa amwinkachu kudi Tata.
Henohu atumbanji twindi amakwawu hiyakufuntamu, kwenda nawa cheŋi nindi nehi.
Dichi Yesu hakwihula ikumi nayedi nindi, Ninenu nawa keŋa muyi kwenu, tahindi?
Kuchinka Shimona Petulu nindi, Tukuyakudinyi? Eyi yeyi wukweti mazu awumi wahaya nyaka.
Tunetiyi, tuneluki netu eyi yeyi Wajila waNzambi.
Yesu hakuyakula nindi, Ami hinayitondeli enu ikumi nayeduku? Ilana mwinenu wumu hidiyabolu.
Komana hakutena Yudasi, mwana kaShimona Isakaroti, muloŋa diyi wamba kamufukeja, diyi wahekumi nayedi.
